items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 94:1
items.html: (To the question) The meaning is not that the first Tevuna, which clothes the TNHY of the upper Aba and Ima, is made in the secret of crouching; rather, there are in the first Tevuna two phases: internality and externality. And the phase of the internality in it returns to its degree in the phase of GAR. And only the externality of this Tevuna descends and diminishes to the phase of crouching. Thus there are now three Tevunot, that is, three phases of Aba and Ima: the first is the upper Aba and Ima, which are from the Chazeh and above of AA. The second is Yeshsut, which clothes the TNHY of the upper Aba and Ima, from the phase of its internality, which is called the first Tevuna. The third is the externality of the first Tevuna, which descended in the phase of crouching, and is called the third Tevuna. Hence they are divided into KHB HGT NHY. (Item 105).
